headline: Tabled property monitoring reports to October meeting; approved discussion and treatment plan for invasive spotted lanternflies.
summary: The commission tabled approval of the July 9 and August 13 minutes and tabled property monitoring reports until the October meeting. Members voted to discuss invasive spotted lanternflies and agreed on a hack-and-squirt herbicide method for treating host trees at open space properties. Staff reported on the farmland lease bid process, with bids due October 8 at 2 pm, and the commission held an executive session on real estate matters.
decisions: Tabled approval of the July 9, 2026 and August 13, 2026 meeting minutes.
Tabled property monitoring reports for Fresh Meadows, Beseck Meadow, 1254 Whirlwind Hill Rd., and 205 Main St, Yalesville until the October meeting.
Approved a motion to discuss invasive spotted lanternflies at the meeting, passed unanimously.

plain_text:
WALLINGFORD CONSERV ATION COMMISSION 
MINUTES of REGULAR MEETING   
Thursday, September 10, 2026 
Room 315, Town Hall, 45 South Main St, Wallingford CT 
 
Meeting called to order:  6:04 pm by Vice-Chairman Bruce Conroy. 
Present: Commissioners Jack Murphy, James Pyskaty, Dianne Saunders, and Erik Severson; Environmental Planner, 
Sebastian Velez.   
Not present: Commissioners Jeff Borne, James Loughlin, Conor Makepeace, Mike Miller. 
There were no members of the public present. 
 
1. Approval of Minutes:  Regular meetings, July 9, 2026, and August 13, 2026 – tabled. 
   
2. TRANSITION PROJECT REPORT – J. Loughlin not present. The Commission asked Sebastian Velez to share his 
environmentally related interests with the group.  Sebastian discussed his interest in invasive plants, his strong interest in 
wetlands and planning. The Commission acknowledged it may take a while for Sebastian to become acclimated to the 
Inland Wetlands work here, before he can commit much time to Conservation Commission work.  In the meantime, he 
will inform the Commission on the which Conservation Commission projects have been approved recently by Inland 
Wetlands, so the Commission will know which projects are ok to move forward.    
 
3. LIST OF TASKS IN PROCESS – Commissioners received a DRAFT list of tasks that have been proposed in 
theory/discussed/approved and for ‘homework’, will consider the items for possible ranking of priority and disposition, 
given the change in staff.  No discussion of tasks or priorities was held at this time, pending everyone’s consideration of 
the list, available resources, time, budget, etc. 
  
4. PROPERTY MONITORING REPORTS – tabled to the October meeting. 
a. Fresh Meadows – J. Borne 
b. Beseck Meadow – M. Miller  
c. 1254 Whirlwind Hill Rd., - J. Pyskaty  
d. 205 Main St, Yalesville – B. Conroy  
e. Other per motion:   
MOTION by J. Pyskaty, seconded by J. Murphy, passed unanimously: to discuss the invasive spotted 
lanternflies at this meeting (not on agenda).  Vice-Chair Conroy reported there are trees of heaven, the host species 
for spotted lanternflies (slf’s’) at Marcus Cooke Park.  Other commissioners have seen the slf’s in various locations 
around town.  Vice-Chair Conroy suggested we have a work party to treat the trees of heaven. Consensus was reached 
that the appropriate method for volunteers for the trees that are at open space properties is to use the hack-and-squirt 
control method and apply an over-the-counter full-strength triclopyr herbicide. The timing window for this is late 
summer (after flowering) to early Fall before the trees stop photosynthesizing. D. Saunders will circulate an email to 
coordinate teams/times for a work party.  One of the Stewards has already been working on this at Tyler Mill 
Preserve.  
 
5. FARMLAND LEASE PROPERTIES PROGRAM  
a. Bid status - Staff – S. Velez reported that one batch of fields has gone out to bid (4A, 4C, 19A, 8B) and bids are due 
by October 8th at 2 pm.  Sebastian reported he is also reviewing another draft from the Water Division. 
  
6. REPORTS / CORRESPONDENCE   
a. Trails Work Group (‘TWG’) – no report received; no one present from TWG. 
b. Other - Staff – no other reports  
  
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION pursuant to CGS §1-200(6)(D) discussion of the lease, sale, or purchase of real estate:
MOTION: E. Severson made a motion at 7:17 pm, seconded by J. Pyskaty, to go into executive session ; 
passed unanimously.   
MOTION: E. Severson made a motion at 7:24 pm, seconded by J. Pyskaty, to come out of executive session; 
passed unanimously. 
  
8. NEXT MEETING – October 8, 2026, 6 p.m.   
  
9. ADJOURNMENT  
 
MOTION: E. Severson made a motion to adjourn the meeting at 7:25 pm, seconded by J. Pyskaty ; passed 
unanimously. 
 
Minutes submitted by D. Saunders
